import java.util.*;

    static final int MOD_A = 998244353;
    static final int MOD_B = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 2000000;
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 1000000;
    static long total_n;
    static long counter;
    static int count_total, answer_value, depth_limit;
    static int[] pw_vals = new int[9];
    static int[] sum_vals = new int[9];
    static List<Integer>[] storage = new ArrayList[9];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            storage[i] = new ArrayList<>();

    }

    static int mod_sub(int x, int y, int m) {
        return (x - y < 0) ? x - y + m : x - y;
    }

    static int mod_add(int x, int y, int m) {
        return (x + y >= m) ? x + y - m : x + y;
    }

    static void build(int level, int val) {
        if (val <= total_n) {
            count_total++;
            int x = mod_sub(count_total, val, MOD_A);
            storage[level - 1].add(x);
            sum_vals[level - 1] = mod_add(sum_vals[level - 1], x, MOD_B);
        }
        if (level > 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) {
            build(level + 1, val * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void process(int level, long current) {
        if (current > total_n) return;
        if (level > 1) {
            if (10L * current * MAX_LIMIT > total_n && (current + 1) * MAX_LIMIT - 1 <= total_n) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) {
                    int x = (int) (((counter - 1L * current * pw_vals[i]) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A);
                    int p = lowerBound(storage[i], MOD_A - x);
                    answer_value = mod_add(answer_value, mod_add((int) ((1L * x * storage[i].size()) % MOD_B), sum_vals[i], MOD_B), MOD_B);
                    answer_value = mod_sub(answer_value, (int) ((1L * MOD_A * (storage[i].size() - p)) % MOD_B), MOD_B);

                counter += count_total;
                return;
            }
            counter++;
            answer_value = mod_add(answer_value, (int) (((counter - current) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A), MOD_B);
        }
        int start = (level == 1) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = start; i <= 9; ++i) {

    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    }
